item_name: Rothco Vintage Canvas Pistol Belt Bag
item_short_desc: Influenced by the classic military pistol belt, Rothco's Vintage Canvas Pistol Belt Bag is great for securely carrying your daily items while offering multi carrying options such as handle straps or a shoulder strap.
description: Large main compartment with zipper closure fits everyday items such as small electronic devices, wallets, notepads, and other daily used items. (Interior features small organizational pockets) Built with T=two exterior pockets, one with zipper closure. Stonewashed cotton canvas provides an authentic vintage look and feel of shoulder bag. Accented with silver pistol belt grommets around the bag and shoulder strap. Adjustable and removable shoulder strap suits most sizes and comfort levels. Pistol belt shoulder bag dimensions: 10” x 13” x 2”
